# Professional Poster Quality Rubric

Use this checklist when reviewing outputs.

## Must Pass

- One primary message is obvious.
- Reading order is clear.
- Headline and key text are legible.
- Composition has balance and intentional negative space.
- Typography feels selected, not random.
- The focal point does not compete with secondary elements.
- The style matches the intended aesthetic.
- The poster is practical for the requested channel and aspect ratio.
- Every CTA/action/status phrase is traceable to exact source wording (or a verified translation with its source quote).
- Poster-level action copy reads as static typography, not as a clickable UI control.

## Common Failure Modes

- Too much text.
- Too many visual ideas.
- Weak contrast.
- Generic template look.
- Fake text, fake logos, or unreadable small details.
- Invented labels such as "敬请期待", "了解更多", "立即选购", "Coming soon", "Learn more", or "Shop now".
- Button, pill, chip, input-field, arrow, or cursor styling around poster-level action copy unless it is part of a product UI explicitly requested by the user.
